message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine statutory charges based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Husband repeatedly battered wife, on June 26 2016 he beat and insulted her, later she fell into river and drowned. Autopsy shows injuries consistent with assault, neck compression, blunt force, causing death. He caused death through intentional injury. Likely charges: (1)故意伤害致人死亡罪 (intentional injury resulting in death) under Article 234 of Criminal Law. Also possibly (2)虐待家庭成员罪 (domestic violence) under Article 260? Actually Article 260 is "虐待被监护、看护的未成年人、老年人、残疾人" but there is also "虐待家庭成员" under Article 260? In Chinese law, "虐待家庭成员罪" is Article 260 (since amendment 2015). So charges: 故意伤害致人死亡罪;虐待家庭成员罪. Also maybe "故意杀人罪"? But the act was not direct killing but caused death via assault; typical charge is "故意伤害致人死亡罪". So answer: [罪名]故意伤害致人死亡罪;虐待家庭成员罪<eoa>
